describe: An on-screen letter keyboard: a grid of keys, one per character of `letters`, row by row. Tapping a key sends input `press {letter}` (extra cells past the last letter are blank and send an empty letter, which the game should ignore). The game must define function `key_state(letter)` returning 0 = untouched ($surface), 1 = good ($primary) or 2 = bad ($danger). The grid is `cols` x `rows` keys of `key_size` px with `gap` px between, top-left at (x, y); `cols * rows` must be at least the number of letters. Defaults fit 26 letters in the lower part of the 360 x 640 canvas.

children.fill: = if _letter_at(cell.y * @cols + cell.x) == '' then '#00000000' else if key_state(_letter_at(cell.y * @cols + cell.x)) == 1 then $primary else if key_state(_letter_at(cell.y * @cols + cell.x)) == 2 then $danger else $surface

children.text: = if _letter_at(cell.y * @cols + cell.x) == ' ' then '␣' else upper(_letter_at(cell.y * @cols + cell.x))
